scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 27 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-civil-settlement-of-niedernberg-n.story: A 161 km round trip from Sulzbach am Main - roughly 2 h 47 in the saddle. On the way it passes Fort site and civil settlement of Grosskro, Watchtowers WP 4/82 to 5/8 including fortl, Watchtowers WP 4/76 to 4/80 including the and back through Watchtowers WP 4/82 to 5/8 including fortl. The line favours views over speed.

places-zacharovanyi-krai-velykyi-dil-chu.story: A 375 km round trip from Dovhe - roughly 6 h 28 in the saddle. On the way it passes Synevyr - Vilshany, Svydovets, Maramarosh and Church of the Nativity of the Virgin. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
